description: This file defines functions related to failover policies, specifically for cooldown probes based on reasons such as rate limiting, overload, billing, and other failure scenarios. It categorizes whether to allow, use, or preserve transient cooldown probes depending on these reasons.

methods.name: export function shouldAllowCooldownProbeForReason( shouldAllowCooldownProbeForReason
methods.description: Determines if a cooldown probe should be allowed based on the given failover reason.

methods.name: export function shouldUseTransientCooldownProbeSlot( shouldUseTransientCooldownProbeSlot
methods.description: Determines if a transient cooldown probe slot should be used for the given reason.

methods.name: export function shouldPreserveTransientCooldownProbeSlot( shouldPreserveTransientCooldownProbeSlot
methods.description: Determines if a transient cooldown probe slot should be preserved based on the reason.
